reminder.notes:
# Reminder 2.30.0 - Smoother in-app updates

### Features
- Update downloads can now be paused, resumed from where they stopped (even after closing the app), stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.

### Bug fixes
- The same error with a different number is now grouped as one issue in error reports.

mirrordrive.notes:
# Mirror 1.1.0 — per-device name for settings backup

### Features
- Per-device name for settings backup. Go to Settings > Settings backup >
  This device to give this phone a name (e.g. "Pixel 8", "Samsung old").
  The name appears in the Drive restore picker so two phones signed into the
  same Google account are easy to tell apart. The auto-generated fallback
  ("Android device · xxxx") is used until a name is set.

### Bug fixes
None — this is a feature-only release.

twinclean.notes:
# TwinClean 1.5.0 - Stable, diagnostics log and smoother updates

### Features
- TwinClean leaves beta: the BETA badge is gone.
- Update downloads can now be paused, resumed from where they stopped (even after closing the app), stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.
- Settings > View diagnostics log records scans, trash actions and updates, with one-tap copy. It never includes file names or paths.

### Bug fixes
- A background scheduler failure no longer crashes the app at launch.
- A crashed scan worker now stops the scan instead of hanging.

mailkeep.notes:
# Mailkeep 0.3.2

### Features
- Empty label scanner: scans custom labels for a given Gmail account to 100% verify 0 emails across live Gmail API stats, Gmail message listing, and local database cache.
- Scanning modal dialog displaying real-time progress and count of verified empty labels.
- Empty label deletion confirmation review dialog listing verified empty labels.
- Immediate app UI removal: empty labels are hidden in real time from drawer, pickers, and folder views upon confirmation.
- 10-minute delayed server deletion: deletion on Gmail server is delayed by 10 minutes, giving the user a persistent safety buffer to revert.
- Persistent countdown banner in Inbox displaying remaining time with a 1-tap "Revert" button.
- Revert / Undo action instantly cancels server deletion and restores labels in the app UI.
- SharedPreferences persistence: delayed deletion timers survive app restarts, continuing countdown or executing if expired.

### Bug fixes
- None (feature update adding 100% empty label scanner with safe 10-minute delayed deletion and revert).
